assessments.name: Final Portfolio
assessments.description: Design a group project implementing music Technology in one of the areas explored during the semester: music production, software instrument design, AI in music, health based music tech (meditative apps), interactive systems for performance or composition

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Students work in pairs to create/continue a 1-minute composition using a virtual instrument plugin (e.g., Kontakt, Serum). Students document their process in relation to the creative process and design concept, formalising it as a 1 slide presentation

assessments.name: Survey of existing technologies
assessments.description: Provide a succinct literature review for at least 5 sources, including journal articles, conference proceedings, book chapters, magazines, interviews, blogs, etc… and use the correct terminology to describe the technical aspects of the chosen topic

assessments.name: Production plan
assessments.description: Provide an overview of the proposed project involving music technology with a production plan, timeline, diagrams where necessary and a listing of group members with each individual role clearly described to enable the completion of the final project
